notes.title: X Mutation: New Character & Co-op Mode Progress Update!
notes.notes:
X Mutation Update: New Character & Co-op Mode Progress! 🚀
Hello X Mutation fans! 👋

We know it’s been a while since our last update, but we’ve been hard at work on two exciting new features for the game: a brand new character and Co-op multiplayer mode!

💥 New Character Progress
We’ve completed the modeling and rigging, and we’re currently working on skills! This new character will bring fresh gameplay mechanics and offer a whole new experience when you step into the battle.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922022/8fba7688d2f80f80bbde7feb00a48784fafcdc69.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922022/277b714facdc99060a31afc78b151d621f7fb08d.jpg

🤝 Co-op Mode Progress
We’ve successfully finished the lobby system and made great strides in connecting players through Steam for seamless co-op gameplay. You’ll soon be able to team up with friends and take on the challenges of X Mutation together!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922022/823492fc65baf0092d2121acc058162979137399.jpg


🚧 What’s Next?
We’re still putting the finishing touches on both features, and we can’t wait to show you more. Stay tuned for more updates and sneak peeks of what’s to come! Your feedback has been invaluable in shaping these new additions, and we can’t thank you enough for your support.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922022/3fee55f90eafb1b75ca4a174db0b8788122b61bd.png



Thank you for your continued support and for being part of the X Mutation journey!

Best,
Projext X

notes.title: Patch Note v0.2.49.0
notes.notes:
Bug fixing:

 Fixed a bug that the first random loot could be "β" version weapons.
 Fixed a bug that in rare cases, the player could continue playing after death.

Progress of new features:

 Co-op:  We already finished the lobby system, and managed connecting players together though Steam.
 New Character: We finished the modeling and map baking, working on texturing right now.

notes.title: Patch Note v0.2.48.0
notes.notes:
New Functionality:

 Added button mapping for controllers in the settings panel.


Bug Fixes:

 Disabled vibration for DualShock controllers due to lack of support in the Unity input system.
 Fixed the issue preventing [Shield Wall] from being used while Auto-Attack is enabled.
 Corrected the display error showing incorrect stat increment values in the leveling up UI.
 Resolved an issue where maximum levels beyond 10 were not functioning correctly with customized settings.

notes.title: Patch v0.2.46
notes.notes:
Game Update Highlights:


 Mutation Level and Stats Adjustment: We've reduced the maximum level of mutations to 5 and doubled the stat upgrades. Based on player feedback, we've rebalanced the game to ease the early stages, challenge the later stages, and quicken the overall pace.
 Hell Mode Timing Change: Hell mode now starts at 40 minutes.
 Upgrade Logic Enhancement: Improved the logic behind random upgrade options for a smoother gameplay experience.
 New Option to Skip Level-ups: Added a "Skip Level-ups for the Remainder of the Match" checkbox, available once most mutations are fully upgraded.
 Bug Fix on Results Screen: Resolved an issue where the results screen could freeze.
 Mutation Stat Rebalance: Adjusted the stats of some mutations to enhance game balance.

We Value Your Feedback and we react ligtning fast:
If you have any feedback or suggestions about the balance adjustments, please join our Discord to discuss with us and contribute to further improvements: Join Our Discord.

notes.title: Patch v0.2.45.0
notes.notes:
Enhanced Melee Weapons: Each rank now offers a noticeable upgrade, enhancing your combat experience.
 Upgraded Passive Abilities: Each rank now unlocks an additional attribute, adding depth and versatility to gameplay.
 Improved Rank Rolling: When rolling for ranks, the result will never be lower than your current rank.
 Synthesis Fix: Corrected an issue where some weapons changed their elemental type after synthesis.
 UI Improvement for German Translation: Addressed space issues in the UI for the German translation, courtesy of Tarynyel. Check it out here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3232816566
 Crate Display Bug Fix: Fixed an issue where banned weapons were still appearing in the first loot crate.

notes.title: Patch v0.2.44.0
notes.notes:
Patch v0.2.44.0

Added Energy Shield Enchantment Tag: Mutations now provide energy shield points through the new 
 Energy Shield Enchantment Tag.
 Fixed UI Bugs: Resolved issues when switching presets in the Customize Settings interface.
 Increased Mob Count: Enhanced the game experience by increasing the number of mobs.
 Adjusted Bullet Distance: Shortened the flight distance of bullets from ranged weapons. The "Attack Range" stat has been updated to extend bullet flight further.
 Corrected Enchantment Tag Display: Fixed an issue where enchantment tags appeared on incorrect mutations.
 Lowered Level Requirement for 'Highland' Map: Reduced the level requirement to unlock the "Highland" map to level 10.
 Bug Fixes on 'Beginner's Bastion' Map: Addressed various issues with the "Beginner's Bastion" map.
 Added Steam Workshop: Introduced the Steam Workshop to the game; currently in beta testing.

notes.title: Patch v0.2.43.0
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where terrain would appear messed up when loading saved games.
 Customize settings are now included in the save data.
 Enhanced camera functionality to allow for further zoom.
 Improved roll animation and extended invincibility time to 0.5 seconds.
 Resolved an issue where the actual attack range did not scale correctly with stats.
 Fixed a bug where enchantment tags from ranged weapons incorrectly appeared on melee weapons.
 Fixed a bug causing potions to disappear when loading a save.
 Added a pop-up window to ask players if they want to use recommended weapons on the training map.
 Improved in-game text for better clarity.

notes.title: Patch v0.2.41.0: Customize Everything Now!
notes.notes:
The major change in 0.2.41.0 is the introduction of the Customize Battle System! 
With the new customization panel, you can adjust virtually everything – from enemy and level settings to upgrade preferences, running speed, jump height, boss count, maximum level of mutations, stat increments upon leveling up mutations, terrain height, and much more. We offer 30 options for you to explore and adjust.

Another significant update is the addition of a training map designed specifically for new players.

We've also doubled the EXP gained from each battle, and the talent map now boosts your stats by 50%-100% more.

Other fixes include:

 Added a UI indicator to show when the mutation crate will spawn, located at the top left corner of the screen.
 Changed the first weapon acquisition to be via a mutation crate, offering three options to choose from.
 Removed the possibility of acquiring useless tags for enchantments.
 Provided two ban points to start with.
 Enhanced jumping mechanics.
 Adjusted the volume of some sound effects.
 Corrected some descriptions for buffs.
 Fixed various bugs.

notes.title: Patch v0.2.40.0 - Talent Map Revamp and Auto Attack Introduction!
notes.notes:
Talent System Revamp:

 Introduced a "Reset Talents" button to reset and regenerate the talent map, returning all spent talent points.
 Added  "Boss DNA" nodes to the talent map, which activates with 3 DNA pieces dropped randomly from specified bosses. Activating these nodes grants powerful, unique abilities.
 Important: Existing account holders are advised to reset their talent maps to prevent issues.


New Features:

 Added an "Auto Attack" option in the settings panel to enable or disable automatic attacks for the primary weapon.
 Added on-screen hints for skipping level-up animations.


Gameplay Adjustments:

 Increased the impact of the "Attack Range" property on melee weapons, enhancing their effectiveness.


Bug Fixes:

 Corrected an issue where some skills and ground blocks appeared overly bright.
 Fixed a bug where exiting the settings panel with a controller caused loss of focus point.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.2.39.0
notes.notes:
- Fixed the jump doesn't react quickly when you press the button with controller.
 - Fixed the Dpad feels laggy when playing with SteamDeck.
 - Fixed bad performance in the title scene when playing with SteamDeck.
 - Fixed game runs poorly with 4k resolution.
 - Added 2560x1440 resoltion in settings panel.
 - Added confirmation pop up when you try to exit settings panel without save.
 - Fixed the "Resume Battle" and "Start New Battle" text stay in the form that happens when you hover over the buttons if you close the menu while the mouse is hovered over the button and reopen this menu.
 - Added detailed informations about how the talent points were calculated in the result screen.
 - Added EXP reward when you pick up looting buffs.
 - Added 1 second invincible time after you exit leveling up or looting screen.
 - Fixed  the playing fall though ground when loading battle saves.
 - Fixed some typo.

notes.title: v0.2.28 Update Notes
notes.notes:
v0.2.28 Update Notes:


 Synthesis system got a makeover! Now, when merging mutations, you won't lose your passive abilities. Instead, they'll be merged by the "Heart."
 Legendary mutations got an upgrade—they're now glowing red and ready to rock!
 Now, you can wield both primary and secondary weapons simultaneously.
 Brace yourselves for 4 brand-new Bosses.
 We've added an in-battle Auto Save/Load system, so you never lose progress.
 Need to ban or unban mutations in a jiffy? Now you can with our new shortcut keys.
 Good news for SteamDeck players—enjoy an enhanced gaming experience.
 Our title page got a facelift, and the text content got spruced up too.
 Performance upgrades mean smoother gameplay all around.
 Animations got a tune-up, and Boss AI got smarter.
 When rerolling rank, the lowest number you can get is now (current rank -1).
 Now the main character in the title page will reflect the mutations you had in the latest battle.
 Bug fixes and improvements across the board.

notes.title: Join the Adventure: Seeking 20 New Testers for X-Mutation's Latest Update! 🎮
notes.notes:
Hello, X-Mutation community!

Thanks to the fantastic feedback from our initial round of testing, we've made a lot exciting improvements and are thrilled to announce that a new version of X-Mutation is now live! For a sneak peek at what's changed, check out our latest promo post right here on Steam.

But here's where the adventure really begins: 
We're looking for 20 new players to join our testing brigade! This is your chance to dive into X-Mutation and help shape its future with your insights and feedback.

What’s New?

 We've balanced, tweaked, and polished, all based on player feedback.
 New features and surprises await, ready for you to discover.


Tester Perks:

 Early access to the latest version of X-Mutation.
 A chance to leave your mark on the game with direct feedback to the development team.


How to Apply: 
Send an email to projectx1901@gmail.com with answers to the following questions:

 Are you a fan of action roguelite games?
 Which action roguelite games have you played before, and approximately how many hours have you spent on them?

notes.title: Update v0.2.15: Major Enhancements and New Features!
notes.notes:
Following the invaluable insights from our first round of private testing, we're excited to unveil substantial updates to X-Mutation! These enhancements are designed to make your gaming experience even more thrilling:


 Game Rebalancing: We've completely overhauled game balance for a more engaging experience.
 New Boss Encounters: Introducing 6 unique bosses that emerge at specific times throughout the game for epic battles.
 Roll Action: Players can now press the alt key or left joystick to roll, gaining 0.3 seconds of invincibility.
 Monster Animation Overhaul: Revamped attack animations with enhanced visual effects make encounters more dynamic.
 AI Improvements: Enemy AI has been upgraded for smarter, more challenging engagements.
 Cool New Mutations:
     Hydra's Grasp: Unleash tentacles that damage nearby foes with the sea's might.
     Seeker's Blades: Deploy daggers that independently target and attack enemies.
 Third Weapon Slot: Customize your arsenal further with the option to equip a second auto-weapon.
 Mutation UI Enhancements: Easily view your current mutations during looting.
 Damage Number Simplification: Color-coded for quick recognition - white for direct damage, red for DoT, blue for elemental reactions, and yellow for critical hits.
 Visual Effects Upgrades: Numerous improvements across the game for a visually stunning experience.
 UI and Bug Fixes: Streamlined mutation management and squashed several bugs for smoother gameplay.


Get ready to dive back in for the second round of private testing starting tomorrow! Your feedback is crucial to making X-Mutation the best it can be.

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. We can't wait to see how you enjoy the new changes!


X-Mutation Dev Team

notes.title: CD-Keys for pre-release test !
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce that our game will be released in April! It's been an incredible journey, and we're so excited to finally reach this milestone. Currently, we're putting the finishing touches on the game, making some final improvements to ensure the best experience for you.

As part of this process, we're offering 10 CD-Keys for an exclusive pre-release test. If you're interested in joining us and providing valuable feedback, we'd love to hear from you!

To apply, please send an email to projectx1901@gmail.com with answers to the following questions:

1, Are you a fan of action roguelite games?
2, Which action roguelite games have you played before, and approximately how many hours have you spent on them?

Your support and feedback are incredibly important to us. Thank you for being a part of our journey!
